78702.subject: Data & Insights: Zuper Zycle; Robinhood Chain ATHs
78702.body:
The Data and Insights newsletter brings the highlights of the week from The Block’s Data Dashboard

( https://www.theblock.co/data/crypto-markets/spot )

Presented by:

BRON ( https://bron.org/?utm_source=TheBlock&utm_medium=Email&utm_campaign=DailyNewsletter )

GM, data bulls! Hope you’re enjoying your long Labor Day weekend! While the broader market is a bit calmer now, we’re still seeing some early signs of onchain mania take form. Let’s keep this up! Our team recently set up a new newsletter titled "Tokenization Briefing." With trillions of dollars of real-world assets migrating onto blockchain rails, we are introducing a way for readers to keep up to date with market insights and visual analyses on what matters in the world of Tokenization. Sign up here ( https://www.theblock.co/newsletters ). Our first issue releases tomorrow!

This week, we’re taking a look at ZEC’s recent monstrous returns and Polymarket’s crypto volumes. We’ll also look at how crypto-related stocks are doing, as well as Robinhood Chain and Hyperliquid. So grab a drink, take a seat, and let's dive in.

1: Zcash Zuper Zycle

( https://www.theblock.co/data/crypto-markets/prices/bitcoin-vs-top-20-marketcap-price-performance-1m )

Chart via The Block's Data Dashboard

*Key Insights* provided by The Block Research

* Zcash's monthly performance has dominated the top 20 coins, returning 86% over the last 30 days, compared to Hyperliquid in second with 53%. Benchmarked to Bitcoin, ZEC has outperformed by more than 2.5 times and, crucially, has passed the $1,000 mark on Friday.
* Zcash was originally a Bitcoin fork with added privacy features leveraging zero-knowledge (ZK) proofs. This enabled features like private peer-to-peer sending while maintaining similar tokenomics and mining functionality to Bitcoin.

* Zcash has two kinds of addresses. Transparent addresses (t-addrs) behave exactly like Bitcoin and are fully public. Shielded addresses (z-addrs) hide sender, receiver, and amount, with validity proven by zk-SNARKs rather than by revealing the data. The dual pool function makes privacy an opt-in feature.

* Zcash has also made waves on Wall Street. The ZEC-associated DAT Cypherpunk Technologies (CYPH) is up more than 200% in the last 30 days, and Grayscale introduced a spot ZEC ETF, which has gained more than $400 million in AUM.

* Both ETF and DAT have signaled ecosystem support for ZCash, with CYPH actively investing in ecosystem projects such as ZODL and Grayscale committing the first year of ETF fees to supporting marketing and the ecosystem.

* With early momentum being so important at the start of cycles, Zcash sits in pole position to continue its run. Narratively, Zcash has been positioned as an upgrade to Bitcoin, solving an age-old question around privacy.

78699.subject: Sanctum Flips Jupiter
78699.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/eaa70932-7ce4-467e-b338-a662ed575d6a/0xR_NL_Banner_Heading_Wordmark.jpg?t=1776775276)
Caption: 

———————————————————————————

Altcoins led the weekend rally, with Raydium and TAO in focus as StonkFun expanded its token launches. Meanwhile, Sanctum has quietly overtaken Jupiter as Solana’s largest protocol by TVL, even as its token trades at a FDV of just $32M.


Today, we unpack the weekend’s market moves and take a closer look at Sanctum’s liquid staking business, its growing revenue and the proposed changes to its token.

———————————————————————————

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/42e942ec-f31d-4957-8722-a3ac7b121e1e/0xR_NL_Market_Update.png?t=1767631151) [Market Update]
Caption: 

Crypto moved higher over the weekend, with the strongest gains coming from altcoins. BTC added just 0.3%, while Modular led with a 26.9% gain and AI and Bittensor rose about 18%. DEXs and Privacy also outperformed, while L1s and memecoins lagged the leaders. Beneath those returns, the weekend brought a new source of activity for Solana’s trading venues.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/bcb60861-9fe2-4c4c-a55d-e91ac4d9afa9/image.png?t=1788785893)
Caption: 

[Raydium gained roughly 58%](https://tools.blockworksresearch.com/api/bwr-api/indices/data/1W/dex_index?family=mcw&include_components=true&include_meta=true) as [StonkFun announced on Saturday that new token launches would run through Raydium’s LaunchLab](https://www.theblock.co/news/defi/2026-09-06-stonk-surges-250-to-140-million-market-cap-as-stock-paired-solana-launchpad-stonkfun-pulls-volume-to-raydium-and-jupiter-413621). StonkFun lets users create tokens paired with assets including tokenized stocks, expanding the range of markets that can feed into Solana’s exchanges. Once a launch reaches its graduation threshold, its liquidity moves into a Raydium pool, where trading continues through Raydium and aggregators such as Jupiter. That gives Raydium a new pipeline of markets and helps explain the enthusiasm for RAY: the opportunity extends beyond the initial token launch into ongoing trading activity.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/ed5b9582-e390-44fc-82c5-b63d174bf338/image.png?t=1788785893)
Caption: 

The AI rally also had a concrete TAO story. On Sunday, [StonkFun added support for token launches paired with TAO](https://www.tao.media/stonkfun-adds-tao-paired-token-launches-as-solana-traders-test-bittensor-liquidity/), with Buttensor (BUTT) among the first examples.
